entries.appliesTo: West Virginia Higher Education Policy Commission (Chancellor), which must develop and administer the Micro-Credential Program

sources.program: §18B-3D-8(c) — 'the West Virginia Micro-Credential Program is established within the West Virginia Higher Education Policy Commission. The Chancellor or their designee shall be responsible for developing and administering the Micro-Credential Program'

flags: minimal AI relevance: AI appears once, as a permitted delivery modality — §18B-3D-8(d)(4) 'Utilize digital, web-based, artificial intelligence-based, hands-on, or on-the-job micro-credentials as needed to meet workforce and market demands' — an authorization, not a duty; the bill imposes no AI-specific obligations
category judgment: bound party is the Higher Education Policy Commission, a state agency, so coded public-sector rather than education; no duties fall on schools/districts/curricula
rulemaking is permissive only: §18B-3D-8(e) 'The commission may propose rules in accordance with §29A-3A-1 et seq.'
no penalty or enforcement provision in the text (exposure omitted per rule 3)
legiscan.js relation is 'similar to HB 4014' only — no replaced-by relation, so not a duplicate
